rules.cwe_name: Data Processing Errors
rules.description: Legacy category for incorrect handling or transformation of structured data.

rules.cwe_name: Function Call With Incorrect Number of Arguments
rules.description: A string formatting operation, such as '"%s: %s, %s" % (a,b)', where the number of conversion specifiers in the format string differs from the number of values to be formatted will raise a TypeError.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic
rules.description: Building a NoSQL query from user-controlled sources is vulnerable to insertion of malicious NoSQL code by the user.

rules.cwe_name: Incorrect Behavior Order: Early Validation
rules.description: A Unicode transformation is using a remote user-controlled data. The transformation is a Unicode normalization using the algorithms "NFC" or "NFKC". In all cases, the security measures implemented or the logical validation performed to escape any injection characters, to validate using regex pattern

rules.cwe_name: Improper Input Validation
rules.description: Data provided remotely is used in this external API without sanitization, which could be a security risk.

rules.cwe_name: Use of a Broken or Risky Cryptographic Algorithm
rules.description: Using version v1 of Azure Storage client-side encryption is insecure, and may enable an attacker to decrypt encrypted data

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
rules.description: Using jinja2 templates with 'autoescape=False' can cause a cross-site scripting vulnerability.

rules.cwe_name: Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling
rules.description: A remote user-controlled data can reach a costly Unicode normalization with either form NFKC or NFKD. rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')
rules.description: Building a SQL query from user-controlled sources is vulnerable to insertion of malicious SQL code by the user.

rules.cwe_name: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site ('Open Redirect')
rules.description: URL redirection based on unvalidated user input may cause redirection to malicious web sites.
